//: Global facts about the website. Everything that appears on more than one page lives here rather than in the page fragments, because a value repeated across three hundred pages drifts on the day one of them is edited alone. The generator (crates/site) refuses to emit a page that still contains an unresolved {{token}}, so a name removed from this file breaks the build instead of leaving a hole on a published page.
//languages: The first entry is the default: it owns the site root and is what hreflang x-default points at. Every other entry is the directory its pages live under (/pl/, /pt-br/, /zh-hans/), so it is lower case, and the build refuses a code that does not equal the language's own html_lang lower-cased - the address and the hreflang cannot be allowed to name two different languages. Adding a language here without adding its file under i18n/ fails the build, and so does an indexable page that has no version in it. The order is the order of the language menu.
//theme: Taken from the product icon (assets/chrono-bean.svg), not chosen separately - #C0392B is the bean body and #E4573F its highlight. The background matches the application's dark theme.
//social_image: The picture is shared by every language; its alternative text is not - it is the social_image_alt key in each i18n/<lang>.json, so a link preview read aloud is in the language of the page that was shared.
//download_sizes: The size of each release download in MiB, as gh release view reports it in bytes divided by 1048576, rounded to two significant digits. Written with a decimal point - each page writes it with its own language's decimal mark (decimal_separator in i18n/<lang>.json) and types the unit beside the token, so a value here is a plain number and the build refuses anything else. Measured on v0.5.0: 68075767, 56872960 and 2692333 bytes. A release that changes them changes this block and no page.
